question.problem: Find the measure of an angle that's supplementary to an angle of $(7x -63)^\circ.$
question.worked_solution:
Two angles are supplementary if their measures add up to $180^\circ.$ 

So, the measure of an angle that's supplementary to an angle of $(7x -63)^\circ$ must be

$$
\begin{aligned}{180}^{∘}-(7x-63)^{∘} & =(180-7x+63)^{∘} \\  & =(180+63-7x)^{∘} \\  & =(243-7x)^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
